content.text: Na khualhaw natu uh in bangma keng heak vun, ciangkhut ahizong, thung a hizing, anluum ahizong, dangka ahizong; puansil ni ahizong in keng heak vun.

Jesus ama nguak thu a nget laitak in, a nungzui te a kungah om uh hi: taciang amate tung ah,

Taciang Jesus in tua thu kuama tung son ngawl tu in thupia a, a khotak in amate vaitha hi;

content.text: Mihing Tapa in tam mama thuak hamtang tu hi, taciang upa te, thiampi lian te le thukhamhil te in nial tu uh a, that tu uh hi, taciang nithum a cin ciang in thokik tu hi,

content.text: A kuamapo ka nung hong zui nuam le, ama le ama ki nial hen a, ama thinglamte nisim pua in, hong zui tahen.
Banghangziam cile a kuamapo in, ama nuntakna a ngum nuam peuma sum tu a: ahihang keima atu in, a nuntakna a sum peuma nungta tu hi.
Mihing khat in leitung buppi a nei hial zong, ama nuntakna sum in bo hile, bang phattuamna om tu ziam?
Banghangziam cile, khatpo in keima le ka thu atu in a maizum le, mihing Tapa sia Ama, Pa le a thiangtho vantungmi te minthanna taw hongpai ciang in, mihing Tapa in zong ama atu maizum pui tu hi.

Jesus Meal Kikheal
Hi thu te a son zawk ni liat ni ciang in, Peter, John le James te sam a, thungen tu in mualtung ah kato tek uh hi.
Thu a nget laitak in, Jesus a maitang meal kikheal a a puan te taang in te liang hi.
Taciang, en vun, mi ni in paupui hi, tuate sia Moses le Elijah te a hi uh hi:
Amate vangletna taw kilang a, Jerusalem ah a thinatu le a nasep a khuangkhim natu thu son uh hi.
Ahihang Peter le a kung a omte sia mutnuam mama uh a: a khuaphaw kik uhciang in, Jesus vangletna le a dinpui mi ni te mu uh hi.

A zingciang, amate mualtung pan a tuaksuk uh ciang in, mi tam mama in Jesus muak uh hi.
